object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Rewrite an object file, a links file and the manifest with CRLF line endings, with different indentation, and with their XML attributes in another order, without changing any text inside an element. Rewrite a figure with a comment, an internal entity and other whitespace between its elements. Compare the latest commit with the working copy; then commit and compare the two commits. Expected: no object changed, and none is Moved. Changing the whitespace inside a figure's text, or re-indenting a figure that isn't well-formed, is still a change.
